cultural.vision_reason: A hand-woven ikat silk scarf with fringed ends, plausibly a northern Thai hilltribe design as the museum notes, consistent with the claimed Thai ethnicity.

physical.title: scarf
physical.summary: Silk scarf, length in single ikat using coloured silks. Fringed at both ends. Probably traditional northern Thai hilltribe design and technique, but adapted to European shape. Made of silk, hand woven.

cultural.vision_reason: A red cotton shoulder-cloth with khit-woven supplementary weft bands (naga diamonds, horse-and-rider, floral and 'S' motifs) is a classic handwoven textile type used across Thailand/Laos, consistent with the claimed Thai attribution.

physical.title: shoulder-cloth
physical.summary: A rectangular cloth, a shoulder-cloth, with identical woven patterning at each end.  Ground made from red tabby cotton cloth (paired warps and wefts); plain centre field.  Deep patterned bands of different widths at each warp end [circa 65 cms].  Widest band has a diamond pattern, each diamond formed from two pairs of naga (mythical snake) motifs.  Also a line of yellow horses with rider; small-scale floral motifs; bird, scrolling and 'S' motifs.  Worked in supplementary weft, 'khit', using mostly yellow cotton yarns, with some green and blue silk yarns.  Warp ends plied and knotted at end.

cultural.vision_reason: Purple silk phasin cloth with silver supplementary-weft floral/tree-of-life border, a traditional Thai skirt fabric form, industrially woven but consistent with regional dress use.

physical.title: weaving sample; skirt (cloth for)
physical.summary: A weaving-sample; a length of purple shot synthetic (?) silk with patterning worked in discontinuous supplementary weft using silver-coloured metal strip.  Black warp; pink/purple weft; tabby woven.  Cloth for a tube skirt, a 'phasin'?; patterning worn as bands.  A 28 cms deep tree-of-life (?) band at one selvedge, triangular in outline, with isolated stylized floral motifs, worked on the diagonal, in the centre field.  Chemically dyed yarns; poor quality materials.  Warp ends raw.  Industrially woven.  Unused.

Below a blue zigzag line, outlined in white, with vertical lines extending to a white fuzzy line below, which runs the length of the cloth; a similar line at top of the cloth.  Cloth for a tube skirt, a 'phasin'?; patterning worn as bands.  Warp ends raw.  Unused.

cultural.vision_reason: A hand-woven cotton tube-skirt (phasin) with striped red/black bands and a plain waistband is a classic Thai/Tai textile form, consistent with the claimed ethnicity.

physical.title: skirt
physical.summary: A woman's tube skirt, a phasin; made of tabby cotton cloth (paired warps).  Predominantly red, with black cotton and some fine yellow and pale blue silk bands (woven as stripes).  Separate band at top [21 cms deep] made of natural cream tabby cotton cloth (also with paired warps).  Top edge raw, lower edge a selvedge.  All joins hand stitched.

cultural.vision_reason: A woven cotton and silk tube skirt (phasin) with supplementary weft diamond bands and confronting bird motifs, a traditional Thai/Lao-Tai style garment consistent with Thai textile culture.

physical.title: skirt
physical.summary: A woman's tube skirt, a 'phasin'.  Made of four unequal sized pieces of cotton cloth with plain and polychrome bands.  Top section [9.5 cms deep] made from pieces of natural cream tabby cotton cloth.  (2) Next section [8 cms deep] has plain red tabby cotton band.  (3) The widest section [49 cms deep] has five identical diamond-patterned bands (lowest one has no zigzag border), worked in supplementary weft, using yellow silk yarn, on a red/brown tabby cotton ground (paired warps and wefts). (4) This band [25 cms deep] has a diamond patterned band, with black contronting birds in middle, worked in discontinuous supplementary weft on a red tabby cotton ground, using white and yellow silk yarns, green, blue and black cotton yarns.  Yellow silk/red cotton selvedge at hemline.  All joins hand stitched.  Some staining of top band.

physical.title: weaving sample
physical.summary: A weaving-sample; a length of weft ikat, 'matmi', patterned shot silk; tabby woven.  Two main registers: two lines of pink/white confronted nagas (snakes), the ends of their bodies touching; patterning in lower register slightly longer and wider than upper.  A white fuzzy line separates this imagery from a geometric band below; a diamond-within-diamond pattern.  Brown warp, red weft; cloth for a tube skirt, a 'phasin'?; patterning worn as bands.  Chemically dyed yarns.  Warp ends raw.  Unused.
